description: An oil painting of a dim, worn interior: an arched-top wooden tabletop radio with a glowing amber dial sits on a rustic plank table beside a chipped enamel mug. Wooden spindle-back chairs surround the table. Through a tall multi-pane window, a grey street shows a doorway with shuttered windows and two old-fashioned cars. No people, no visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
